reports.title: Transcript abundance and reagent mass in a shared claim

findings.message: Claim compares mass, ratio measurements without a conversion model.
findings.action: Add a validated conversion model or split the claim by dimension.

findings.message: reagent-mass uses mass, but the claim expects ratio.
findings.action: Correct the unit or rewrite the claim to match the measured dimension.

findings.message: daily-window is normalized per day, but the claim is per hour.
findings.action: Normalize all evidence to the same denominator.
Recalculate the derived result from source measurements.

findings.message: Derived fold change uses more significant digits than the source measurements justify.
findings.action: Round the claim to precision supported by source measurements.

findings.message: well-a-density is missing required volume normalization evidence.
findings.action: Add the missing normalization basis before review.
